title: The writer option
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json skipNullOn="objects"
---
{ a: null, b: "", c: [null, { d: null }] }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json skipNullOn="objects"
---
{ a: null, b: "", c: [null, { d: null }] }

explanation.approach: Null fields go at every depth. The empty String stays.
